occurrences.finding: Garbage Inaccessible to Children; Maintained in Sanitary Manner: Multiple classrooms were observed to have garbage accessible to children during inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Garbage Inaccessible to Children; Maintained in Sanitary Manner (26 TAC §746.3407(8))

occurrences.finding: Nutrition and Food Service - Follow Meal Patterns: Children were only served veggie sticks for PM snack during the inspection. Menus reviewed show that the operation has not been serving two components.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Nutrition and Food Service - Follow Meal Patterns (26 TAC §746.3301(b))

occurrences.finding: CPR Training and Recertification Adhere to Guidelines-skill based: The opeation has one caregiver that has online only CPR.
occurrences.violation_type_title: CPR Training and Recertification Adhere to Guidelines-skill based (26 TAC §746.1315(b)(1))

occurrences.violation_type_title: Activities for Infants - Outdoor Play Daily (26 TAC §746.2417(1))

occurrences.finding: Policies Comply with Rules: The operational policies were missing the following;  (15) water activites,  (17) animals,  (18) duration of indoor and outdoor physical,  (19) Procedures for providing and applying sunscreen and bug spray.  (24) the emergency prepardness plan,  (30) Procedures for supporting inclusive services to children with special care needs.
